name: RF Emission & Susceptibility Analysis
description: Device-level characterization of unintentional RF emissions from hardware and evaluation of device susceptibility to external RF interference. Covers conducted and radiated emission measurement, RF emission profiling of cryptographic operations, and assessment of device resilience to intentional electromagnetic interference. TEMPEST-standard compromising emanation analysis belongs to WSEC-SPEC-TEMPEST.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to RF emission or susceptibility analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands compromising emanations and RF susceptibility concepts
evidence: Can explain the concept of compromising emanations and TEMPEST at a high level
Understands the difference between near-field EM (SCA) and far-field RF emission analysis
Aware of conducted vs. radiated emission measurement approaches

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic RF emission measurements and profiling under supervision
evidence: Configures RF measurement chain (antenna, LNA, spectrum analyzer) for emission measurement
Captures RF emission spectra from a target device during security-relevant operations
Identifies data-correlated emission peaks in frequency-domain measurements with guidance
Operates in an RF shielded chamber following documented measurement procedures

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs RF emission analysis and susceptibility testing on real targets
evidence: Identifies and characterizes compromising emanations from production devices
Correlates far-field RF emissions with data-dependent device operations
Performs conducted susceptibility testing to assess device resilience to RF interference
Completed RF emission/susceptibility assessments on 3+ targets with documented findings

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Performs advanced emanation exploitation; develops measurement methodology; mentors team
evidence: Exploits compromising emanations at distance to extract useful intelligence from target devices
Develops custom RF emission measurement and analysis workflows
Assesses shielding effectiveness and EMC countermeasure implementations
Mentors team on RF measurement technique, antenna selection, and analysis methods

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on RF emission security; defines methodology; specifies measurement equipment
evidence: Defines the lab's RF emission and susceptibility analysis methodology
Specifies RF measurement equipment and shielded chamber requirements
Published research on compromising emanation exploitation or countermeasures
Provides expert consultation on emanation security to product designers

assessment_methods.description: Perform RF emission analysis on a prepared target device: measure emission spectrum, identify data-correlated emissions, and assess information leakage risk
Observe measurement setup, antenna positioning, and signal analysis technique during a live RF emission assessment

equipment: RF shielded anechoic chamber or GTEM cell
Calibrated measurement antenna set (biconical, log-periodic, horn)
EMI receiver / spectrum analyzer with pre-compliance measurement capability
